text.tspan: Imports PDF receipts from selected files/folders into the existing receipts table. It OCRs each PDF using the
documents tool, extracts structured fields via an agent, checks duplicates (vendor+date+total+receipt_number),
and supports two run modes: preview-only (default) or automatic insert. It also supports configurable duplicate
and missing-field handling, provides progress updates, uses batched insertMany writes, and prints a clear summary
with skipped/error files.

text.tspan: Imports PDF receipts from selected files/folders into the existing receipts table. It OCRs each PDF using the
documents tool, extracts structured fields via an agent, checks duplicates (vendor+date+total+receipt_number),
and supports two run modes: preview-only (default) or automatic insert. It also supports configurable duplicate
and missing-field handling, provides progress updates, uses batched insertMany writes, and prints a clear summary
with skipped/error files.
